evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; the growth stage requires tube pressure, so the atmosphere cannot be fully verified
Ramp tracked setpoint; small overshoot to 760.5 then settled at 750.0
Steady at about 46% during growth, consistent with a stable hold
O2 fell to about 5-8 ppm after purge and stays low, so there is no sign of a large air leak

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading (install a gauge or check pressure by hand) would rule out an exhaust blockage or pressure deviation. Post-run characterization of the sample would show whether growth happened.
